culpritSource.quote: According to that, Conan figured out almost everything: the culprit is Naho Mimura, without a doubt. The culprit must be some one who knows Chiaki and has her phone number, otherwise Chiaki would not be able to be directly called by the culprit. Being a college classmate with Naho, Chiaki recognises very well the smell that permeated the room Tetsuya got kidnapped, in which Naho always had fancied this type of fragrance.

motive.quote: Megure, on the other hand, remarked that he did not like the culprit's plan, because he realised this: At the outset kidnappers were using fairly amateur-ish language to conduct the abduction, ever since the stage of hostage exchanging, the tone of the culprit had changed drastically.

method.quote: After the call had hanged up, everyone working in the case were rather anxious.

evidence.quote: By looking up the construction sites currently in operation online, Conan found the one located with the shortest displacement with respect to the Toto Tower.

motive.zhHans: 另一方面，目暮指出他不喜欢犯人的计划，因为他察觉到了这一点：起初绑匪在实施绑架时使用的是相当业余的语言，而自从人质交换阶段起，犯人的语气发生了剧变。由于两辆车将以指定速度行驶，犯人完全有可能实时掌握它们的位置。如果犯人已经公开了车辆的明确位置，那么金钱与人质的交换就可能是某种幌子；这样一来，犯人可能并非完全为了赎金。为了让 Sakae 继承 Mimura 公司的家业，她能做的只有杀死 Kazuo。
motive.en: Megure, on the other hand, remarked that he did not like the culprit's plan, because he realised this: At the outset kidnappers were using fairly amateur-ish language to conduct the abduction, ever since the stage of hostage exchanging, the tone of the culprit had changed drastically. Since the two vehicles will be travelling at specified speed, it would be perfectly possible for the culprit to keep track of them in real-time. If the culprit had disclosed the plain location of the vehicles, it is possible that the money-hostage exchanging is a decoy or some sort; upon that, the culprit might not after the ransom completely. For Sakae to inherit the Mimura company legacy, all she could do was to murder Kazuo.

method.zhHans: 电话挂断后，参与办案的每个人都相当焦急。另一方面，目暮指出他不喜欢犯人的计划，因为他察觉到了这一点：起初绑匪在实施绑架时使用的是相当业余的语言，而自从人质交换阶段起，犯人的语气发生了剧变。
method.en: After the call had hanged up, everyone working in the case were rather anxious. Megure, on the other hand, remarked that he did not like the culprit's plan, because he realised this: At the outset kidnappers were using fairly amateur-ish language to conduct the abduction, ever since the stage of hostage exchanging, the tone of the culprit had changed drastically.

evidence.zhHans: 通过在网上查找目前正在运营的施工工地，柯南找到了相对于 Toto Tower 位移最短的那一处。
evidence.en: By looking up the construction sites currently in operation online, Conan found the one located with the shortest displacement with respect to the Toto Tower.
